selection_rules.how_to_choose: Use npm run design:route -- "<pedido>". The active runtime in src/modules/direction/presets/router.ts resolves niche terms from local-presets.json; style tokens are returned only as candidates and must be checked against project identity, user requirements and applicable accessibility constraints.
selection_rules.tie_breaker: Equal-strength preset matches return status=ambiguous, confidence=low and requiresConfirmation=true. Do not break ties by array order, style description or aesthetic preference; ask the user or retain alternatives.
selection_rules.mode_rule: Use the mode and tokens from the resolved style only after the route is accepted. A light/dark variant is available only when a variant condition is explicitly matched in that preset; confirm ambiguous variants instead of guessing.
selection_rules.override_rule: Respect explicit project and user constraints, verified existing tokens and applicable normative/accessibility requirements. A requested style or token does not remove the need to evaluate actual contrast, focus, keyboard and responsive behavior.
selection_rules.no_match_rule: No match returns clean_editorial as a provisional neutral fallback with low confidence and requiresConfirmation=true. The router does not score this file's style keywords as a fallback selector.
selection_rules.tone_rule: CLI --tone accepts calm|loud and changes intensity only. It does not select a niche, style family or layout.

global_constraints.guidance_scope: These values are starting recommendations, not universal layout laws or automatic defect thresholds. Use project tokens and task context first.
global_constraints.spacing_grid: Reuse the project's documented spacing scale. If none exists, establish a consistent scale from the content, density, touch targets and responsive needs; 4px/8px increments are a convention, not a rigid validation rule.
global_constraints.heading_tracking_range: Use the selected style's heading_tracking_range as a suggestion, then verify actual font rendering, language and legibility. Do not force tracking values that damage readability.
global_constraints.min_text_contrast: Evaluate actual rendered foreground/background pairs against the applicable WCAG success criterion and text size. Account for opacity, overlays, images and gradients; static token values alone do not prove contrast.
global_constraints.accent_usage: Use semantic accent roles for actions and meaningful emphasis. Any intensity percentages are optional visual guidance, not hard quotas or automatic pass/fail rules. Product artwork is distinct from UI accent.
precedence: current user instruction and explicit deliverable
verified project behavior, existing brand and approved design tokens
applicable accessibility, platform, legal and technical constraints
accepted contextual style direction and domain profile
general visual preferences and heuristic recommendations
